event_text: The safety check in hex.pm's request decoder is removed, leaving the flaw in place
The attacker's two addresses repeatedly download hex.pm's own dependencies, which Hex says suggests a test copy was being built
69 malicious requests reach hex.pm; commands run on six web servers
Every hex.pm server is running a fixed build; a firewall rule blocks the attacker two minutes later
A separate security report describing the same flaw reaches Hex by email
Hex reports the breach to the Swedish data protection authority, CISA and ENISA
Hex has replaced every credential the attacker could have read except the registry signing key and a few low-impact secrets
Hex publishes its incident post and the flaw is published as CVE-2026-129514
notes: Hex gives 13:48 UTC for the CVE.
